job.title: Senior Client Manager – Employee Benefits
job.description:

Our client is seeking an experienced Senior Client Manager to manage and grow a portfolio of corporate Employee Benefits clients. 
 
This role combines strategic client relationship management, benefits consulting and business development, with a focus on delivering tailored solutions, optimising benefits programmes and driving sustainable portfolio growth.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the end-to-end renewal process, including strategic planning, insurer negotiations, placement, implementation and ongoing servicing.

  • Prepare and present renewal proposals, portfolio reviews and strategic recommendations to key stakeholders.
  • Oversee complex servicing and claims escalations, ensuring timely resolution and high client satisfaction.
  • Support business development initiatives, including prospect meetings, tenders, proposals and client presentations.
  • Identify cross-selling opportunities to strengthen client relationships and drive portfolio growth.
  • Ensure adherence to regulatory requirements, internal policies, and service standards.

Requirements
  • A minimum of 7 years of experience in employee benefits broking, consulting, or corporate client management.
  • Strong knowledge in group insurance products, insurer relationships and market practices.
  • Proven experience managing corporate accounts, renewals, insurance placements and insurer negotiations.
  • Strong analytical capabilities, particularly in claims analysis, loss ratios, benefits benchmarking and cost management.
  • Commercially driven, with experience supporting new business development and client acquisition.

job.title: Site Reliability Engineer (Production Support)
job.description:
Client introduction
Our client is an established fintech headquartered in Singapore, operating across cross-border payments and foreign exchange.

As the business continues to scale, they are strengthening the reliability and production support function that keeps their live platforms stable. This is a newly created Site Reliability Engineer (Production Support) role within the SRE team, reporting to the Head of SRE.

The role starts as a hands-on individual contributor, with a genuine path to grow into a lead position over the next one to two years as part of succession planning.
 
Job responsibilities
  • Own day-to-day production support across live FX and payments platforms.
  • Monitor production environments and respond to alerts, incidents and system issues.
  • Investigate production issues by reviewing dashboards, logs, metrics and application behaviour.
  • Use monitoring and log aggregation tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog, OpenSearch, Kibana and Logstash.
  • Configure, refine and improve alerts so issues are detected early and escalated properly.
  • Lead incident response, root-cause analysis and follow-up actions to prevent recurring issues.
  • Write Bash and Python scripts to automate support activities, improve troubleshooting and reduce manual work.
  • Work with product, operations, engineering and infrastructure teams to route and resolve issues effectively.
  • Set up production support, monitoring and incident-response processes for new products and platform changes.
  • Maintain runbooks, operational documentation and support procedures.
  • Assist with technical client integration or onboarding issues when needed, alongside a dedicated client-support team.
  • Over time, grow into a broader lead role within the production support and SRE function.
 
Job requirements
  • At least 7 years in production support, application support, site reliability or technical operations.
  • Experience supporting production systems in a bank or financial institution is advantageous.
  • Strong experience supporting live production environments - alerts, incidents, troubleshooting, escalation and operational follow-through.
  • Hands-on with monitoring tools (Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog or similar) and log aggregation tools (OpenSearch, Kibana, Logstash, ELK, Splunk or similar).
  • Good scripting ability in Bash, Python or similar.
  • Able to troubleshoot production issues using logs, metrics, dashboards, application behaviour and system indicators.
  • Familiarity with incident management, RCA, SLA/SLO practice, runbooks and production support processes.
  • Exposure to Kubernetes, cloud environments or containerised applications is useful.
  • QA, UAT or release-validation exposure is a plus, but not the main focus of the role.
  • Client-facing experience is a plus but can be trained - the more important requirement is strong production support and troubleshooting ability.
 
Why you should join them
  • Newly created role with a genuine path to grow into a lead position over time.
  • Strong ownership across production support, monitoring, incident response and platform stability.
  • Work on live FX and payments platforms within a growing fintech environment.
  • Broad exposure across production operations, SRE practice, monitoring, scripting, support processes and cross-functional issue resolution.
  • Direct exposure to the Head of SRE and the engineering, infrastructure, product and operations teams.
  • A chance to shape how production support and reliability processes mature as the business scales.

Are you a passionate software engineer who thrives on solving complex challenges, building scalable solutions, and leading technical innovation?

We're looking for an experienced Lead Software Engineer to join a high-performing technology team delivering impactful digital products that make a real difference. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who wants to remain hands-on with development while expanding their influence across architecture, technical leadership, engineering excellence, and strategic decision-making. 
 
Why This Opportunity Stands Out
This role offers far more than coding.

You'll have the chance to:
  • Lead the technical direction of meaningful, large-scale digital solutions
  • Influence architecture and technology decisions that shape product success
  • Mentor and inspire talented engineers while growing your own leadership capabilities
  • Work with modern development practices, cloud technologies, DevOps, and automation
  • Collaborate with passionate cross-functional teams dedicated to engineering excellence
  • Contribute to projects that have real-world impact and long-term significance 
 
If you're seeking a role where your technical expertise is valued, your ideas are heard, and your contributions drive tangible outcomes, we'd love to hear from you.
 
What You'll Be Doing

As a Lead Software Engineer, you'll play a key role in designing, developing, and delivering high-quality software solutions while providing technical guidance across projects and teams. Responsibilities include:
  • Driving technical solutions and engineering best practices
  • Designing scalable, secure, and maintainable applications
  • Leading code reviews and contributing to architectural discussions
  • Collaborating with product, design, QA, and infrastructure teams
  • Guiding and mentoring fellow engineers
  • Supporting modern DevOps, CI/CD, testing, and automation practices
  • Solving challenging technical problems and identifying innovative approaches to delivery 

What We're Looking For
We're interested in engineers who bring both technical depth and leadership capability.

You will ideally have:
  • 8+ years of software development experience
  • Experience leading technical initiatives, teams, modules, or workstreams
  • Strong knowledge of software architecture and solution design
  • Expertise in technologies such as Java, C#, TypeScript, React, Angular, Next.js, or similar modern frameworks
  • Experience working with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, MSSQL, Oracle, or equivalent
  • Strong understanding of APIs, microservices, Agile delivery, DevOps, and secure development practices
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills
  • A passion for continuous improvement, innovation, and mentoring others 

What's In It For You?
We believe great engineers deserve great opportunities.

You'll enjoy:
  • Exposure to challenging, high-impact technology projects
  • Opportunities to influence technical strategy and architecture
  • A collaborative and supportive engineering culture
  • Continuous learning and professional development opportunities
  • Access to modern tools, technologies, and development environments
  • A clear pathway to further leadership and technical growth
  • The chance to make a meaningful contribution while staying technically hands-on 

Ready for Your Next Challenge?
If you're looking for a role where you can lead, innovate, mentor, and build solutions that truly matter, we'd love to connect with you.

job.title: Compliance Manager - 3 - 6 month contract
job.description:
• Compliance Manager - Incident Managemet
  • 3-6 Month contract
  • $830per day
Clear a defined backlog of compliance incidents for a major APRA‑regulated financial services organisation.

This is a short‑term, high‑impact contract suited to someone who knows compliance incident management inside out and enjoys tidy, contained pieces of work. You’ll step in, take ownership of a backlog of compliance incidents, and work through them methodically — triage, assess, document, close. No transformation program. No endless stakeholder circus. Just focused delivery.
You’ll work with senior compliance stakeholders to ensure incidents are accurately categorised, root causes validated, and documentation meets APRA/ASIC expectations. If you like structured work, clear outcomes and getting things done without the fluff, this is a great fit.

What you’ll do
  • Work through a backlog of compliance incidents
  • Complete triage, assessment, documentation and closure
  • Ensure alignment with APRA/ASIC regulatory expectations
  • Provide clear, simple reporting and updates
  • Support small compliance uplift tasks as needed
About You (Prerequisites)
  • You bring the core capabilities of a senior compliance professional in an APRA‑regulated environment:
  • Experience in an APRA and/or ASIC‑regulated financial services organisation
  • Proven experience managing compliance incidents end‑to‑end
  • Strong understanding of APRA, AUSTRAC, ASIC, AFCA, OAIC, ACCC and AFSL obligations
  • Ability to interpret regulation and turn it into practical, business‑ready requirements
  • Experience with risk and compliance monitoring programs
  • Excellent written communication and attention to detail
  • Strong judgement, prioritisation and ability to keep things simple
  • Financial crime compliance experience is not relevant for this role
What’s in it for you
  • 3–6 month contract
  • Clear, contained piece of work
  • Competitive daily rate
  • Sydney CBD + flexible working
For further information or to confidentially apply, contact Matt Quinn on +61 2 8227 9200 or mattq@ethosbc.com.au.

  • Drive cross-functional planning across clinical, regulatory, CMC, biomarker, safety and clinical supply
  • Act as the primary interface with CDMOs, aligning manufacturing and clinical-supply timelines
  • Track critical-path risks and vendor performance, and resolve issues proactively

What you bring

  • China/APAC clinical development experience, with global exposure preferred
  • Fluency in English is required for cross-functional communication, and professional proficiency in Mandarin is required for direct communication, technical discussions and coordination with China-based biotech partners and clinical development stakeholders.
  • A hands-on, detail-oriented style and comfort being the single point of accountability in a lean team

job.title: Key User Sales Support Manager

This role combines B2B sales, strategic account management, and customer training, offering the opportunity to build long-term customer relationships while ensuring customers maximise the value of the company's products and solutions.
The successful candidate will work closely with Sales, Marketing, Product and Customer Support teams to identify growth opportunities, improve customer experience and drive commercial performance.

About the Company
Our client is a leading multinational organisation with a strong presence across industrial technology, consumer products and professional solutions.
Recognised for its commitment to innovation, product quality and customer-centric solutions, the organisation operates across international markets and continues to invest in customer engagement, product development and commercial excellence.
 
Key Responsibilities
Sales & Key Account Management
  • Manage and develop relationships with assigned key accounts, ensuring strong customer engagement and long-term business partnerships.
  • Drive the end-to-end sales process, including prospecting, customer engagement, solution presentations, proposal development and deal closure.
  • Identify new business opportunities and drive account growth through upselling, cross-selling and customer retention initiatives.
  • Develop strategic account plans, map key stakeholders and identify opportunities to expand product penetration.
  • Maintain a healthy sales pipeline and contribute to revenue forecasting and commercial planning.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to deliver effective solutions aligned with customer requirements.

Customer Training & Product Enablement
  • Develop and execute customer training initiatives to improve product knowledge, user confidence and adoption.
  • Conduct product demonstrations, onboarding sessions, workshops and refresher training for key customers and end users.
  • Assess customer training needs and identify opportunities to improve product utilisation.
  • Develop and maintain training materials, product guides, presentations and digital learning resources.
  • Evaluate training effectiveness through customer feedback, assessments and product adoption metrics.
  • Partner with Customer Support and Product teams to address user challenges and continuously improve the customer experience.

Sales Operations & CRM Management
  • Maintain accurate CRM records covering customer interactions, sales opportunities, pipeline activities and training engagements.
  • Monitor sales performance, account development and customer engagement metrics.
  • Prepare regular reports on pipeline progression, sales activities and training effectiveness.
  • Leverage customer insights and market feedback to identify commercial opportunities and support business decisions.
  • Ensure effective coordination between commercial and technical teams to deliver a seamless customer experience.

Requirements
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering or a related discipline.
  • Approximately 5–8 years of experience in B2B Sales, Key Account Management, Customer Success, Technical Sales or related commercial functions.
  • Experience within industrial products, power tools, electrical equipment, hardware, or related technical product industries would be advantageous.
  • Proven ability to manage customer relationships, identify business opportunities and drive sales performance.
  • Strong presentation and communication skills, with experience conducting product demonstrations or customer training.
  • Comfortable engaging stakeholders across different organisational levels, from frontline users to senior decision-makers.
  • Familiarity with CRM platforms such as Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics or equivalent systems.
  • Strong commercial acumen, analytical capabilities and customer-centric problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Experience in user enablement, product education or technical training would be an added advantage.

What's on Offer
  • Opportunity to join an established multinational organisation with a strong market presence.
  • A commercially focused role combining key account development, customer engagement and product training.
  • Exposure to a broad portfolio of technology-driven products and solutions.
  • Collaborative working environment with opportunities for professional development and career progression.
  • Competitive remuneration package and employee benefits.
 
Apply Now
If you are a commercially driven professional with a passion for B2B sales, customer relationship management and product training, we would be keen to hear from you.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

  • 6-Month Contract | Up to $650/day + Super

We are seeking an experienced Document Writer to support a major operational readiness program within its Operations Management function. This initial 6 month contract will focus on developing the operational and management-system documentation required to support the transition of vehicle ferry services to a new operating model. Working closely with operational SMEs, Safety, WHS, Quality and Risk teams, you will translate complex operational requirements into clear, practical and compliant documentation.

You will develop, review and maintain a broad range of operational and management-system documentation, including: 
  • Operational procedures, manuals, templates and reference materials
  • Safety management, quality and environmental documentation
  • Operations and maintenance manuals
  • Risk assessments, training matrices and site induction documentation
  • Documentation supporting ISO certification, accreditation and compliance requirements
  • Version control, document approvals and publication processes
  • Supporting reports, spreadsheets and operational readiness materials
  • Documentation of operational processes, assurance findings and lessons learned
About you
  • Proven experience developing high-quality operational or technical documentation, ideally within a large, safety-focused, transport, infrastructure or government environment
  • Experience developing management-system documentation across safety, quality and/or environmental functions
  • Knowledge of ISO-aligned management systems, certification, accreditation and compliance requirements
  • Strong experience producing operational procedures, manuals, templates and reference materials
  • Understanding of document and records management, including version control, accuracy, approvals and information governance
  • Ability to work with operational SMEs and translate complex technical and procedural information into clear, practical documentation
  • Strong stakeholder-management skills across Safety, WHS, Quality, Risk and operational teams
  • Strong Microsoft Word and Excel skills, with experience preparing professional PDF documentation
  • Ability to manage multiple documentation priorities and deliver within tight project timeframes
Attendance at the Windsor office is required one day per week as this is where they key team and stakeholders are based. Other days can be worked from any of the other 6 offices across Sydney. This would suit an experienced Document Writer who understands that operational documentation needs to be more than well written. It must be practical, controlled, compliant and usable by frontline operational teams. if the above matches your skill-set and experience, please apply NOW and you will be contacted for a further discussion if your profile is deemed a suitable match.

  • You will be responsible for designing secure, scalable and resilient Azure solutions while working closely with engineering teams to take solutions from architecture and design through to implementation

Key responsibilities
  • Design end-to-end Azure architecture and produce high-quality solution designs, HLDs and LLDs.

  • Architect Azure infrastructure and networking across VNets, Hub-and-Spoke, Azure Firewall, NSGs, Private Endpoints, ExpressRoute/VPN, DNS and hybrid connectivity.

Our client, a leading international law firm, is hiring an Associate or Senior Associate to join its Singapore corporate team, working on cross-border M&A, private equity and venture capital transactions across Southeast Asia and India for financial sponsors, investors, multinationals and high-growth companies.

  • Senior Associates: mentor junior lawyers and contribute to know-how and training.

  • Common law qualified.

  • Corporate M&A and/or private equity experience at an international or leading regional law firm, ideally on cross-border matters.

  • Strong drafting and negotiation skills, with the ability to run transaction workstreams with limited supervision.
  • Commercial judgment, a practical, client-focused approach and English proficiency are required for the effective performance of the role, including legal drafting, preparation of transaction and due diligence documents, negotiation, client communication, and coordination with clients, counterparties, advisers and local counsel in cross-border transactions.

• Delivery Process Lead
  • Up to $900 + Super per day
  • Initial 6-Month Contract

We're seeking an experienced Delivery Process Lead to join a Delivery Office responsible for shaping and scoping digital and technology initiatives before they progress into formal delivery.

Working across a diverse portfolio of digital and ICT initiatives, you'll lead pre-discovery and discovery activities, taking often ambiguous business needs and turning them into clearly defined, scoped and decision-ready initiatives. You'll coordinate Business Analysts and technical SMEs to develop high-quality Statements of Work (SOWs), scope documentation, estimates, business case inputs and executive-ready recommendations. A key focus of the role is bringing structure to the early stages of the delivery lifecycle – clarifying the problem to be solved, defining scope boundaries, assessing complexity, validating resource and cost estimates and ensuring the right technical and business stakeholders have contributed before an initiative progresses.

You'll work closely with Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security, Vendor Management, Digital Engagement and other specialist teams, facilitating workshops, challenging assumptions and ensuring initiatives are appropriately scoped and ready for endorsement and mobilisation.

The ideal background could be a Senior/Lead Business Analyst, Delivery Lead, Transformation Lead or Project Manager with strong experience across discovery and early-stage initiative shaping. This isn't a traditional delivery PM or Senior BA role – we're looking for someone comfortable working through ambiguity, developing structure and producing clear, high-quality documentation that enables informed investment and delivery decisions.

Key Responsibilities
  • Lead pre-discovery and discovery activities for digital and technology initiatives
  • Translate ambiguous business needs into clearly defined problem statements, scope and delivery options
  • Coordinate Business Analysts and specialist SMEs throughout the discovery process
  • Develop high-quality Statements of Work (SOWs), scope documentation and executive-ready artefacts
  • Coordinate and validate estimates, resource requirements, costs and delivery approaches
  • Facilitate workshops and challenge assumptions to ensure initiatives are appropriately defined
  • Coordinate inputs across Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security, Vendor Management and other specialist teams
  • Establish appropriate governance, delivery cadence and ways of working
  • Support initiative prioritisation, endorsement and investment decision-making
  • Identify opportunities to improve and mature the pre-delivery/discovery process
Essential Experience
  • Strong experience leading pre-discovery, discovery or early-stage initiative scoping
  • Demonstrated experience developing Statements of Work (SOWs) and other decision or mobilisation documentation
  • Strong business analysis, problem definition and process analysis capability
  • Experience taking ambiguous requirements and turning them into clearly defined, actionable initiatives
  • Strong stakeholder engagement and workshop facilitation skills
  • Experience coordinating technical SMEs and multidisciplinary stakeholders
  • Experience developing scope, estimates, resource requirements and delivery recommendations
  • Experience across digital, technology or ICT transformation initiatives
  • Excellent written communication and the ability to produce concise, executive-ready documentation
Highly Desirable
  • Experience leading or mentoring Business Analysts
  • Experience developing business cases or investment submissions
  • Experience supporting portfolio prioritisation or investment decisions
  • Experience establishing or improving discovery, governance or delivery frameworks
  • Experience within a large, complex organisation or higher education environment

job.title: Associate / Senior Associate, Restructuring (Singapore)
job.description:
Role Overview
Our client, a reputable international law firm, is hiring an Associate or Senior Associate to join its Singapore restructuring team, working on complex cross-border debt restructurings across Asia, for corporates, sponsors, creditors and other stakeholders.
 
Title: Associate / Senior Associate, Restructuring & Insolvency
Location: Singapore (regional work across Asia-Pacific)
Reports to: Partner, Restructuring & Insolvency
Experience: Associate: 3–5 years PQE | Senior Associate: 5–8+ years PQE
Practice mix: Restructuring and insolvency, with exposure to debt finance and cross-border M&A
 
You will work closely with the partner on high-value, multi-jurisdiction restructurings involving syndicated loans, bonds and other debt. You will also support acquisition, project and other financings, and M&A and joint ventures, often for the same corporate clients. Senior Associates will run workstreams day to day and act as the main point of contact for clients and local counsel.
 
Key Responsibilities
 
Restructuring and insolvency (core practice)
  • Advise companies, sponsors, creditors and other stakeholders on cross-border debt restructurings, from early contingency planning through to implementation.
  • Draft and negotiate key documents, including restructuring support agreements, term sheets, intercreditor agreements, scheme documents and new debt and equity instruments.
  • Help run court-supervised processes such as schemes of arrangement, moratoria and judicial management, including preparing court filings and evidence.
  • Assist with the recognition of restructuring proceedings in foreign jurisdictions.
  • Research and analyse debt documents, identifying creditor rights, voting thresholds and restructuring options.
  • Coordinate local counsel and advisers across multiple jurisdictions and manage closing and implementation checklists.
  • Senior Associates: lead workstreams, attend and run parts of creditor negotiations, and supervise junior associates and trainees.

Finance and corporate
  • Draft and negotiate facility agreements and security documents for acquisition, project, receivables-backed and syndicated financings.
  • Support cross-border M&A, joint ventures and distressed acquisitions and disposals, including due diligence and transaction documents.

Team and business development
  • Prepare client updates, articles, pitch materials and directory submissions.
  • Build relationships with peers at financial advisers, turnaround firms, banks and insolvency practitioners.
  • Senior Associates: mentor junior lawyers and contribute to know-how and training.
 
Requirements 
  • Qualified in England and Wales; Singapore qualification, or eligibility to register as a foreign lawyer in Singapore, is an advantage.
  • Associate: 3–5 years' PQE. Senior Associate: 5–8+ years' PQE.
  • Restructuring and insolvency experience at an international or leading regional law firm, ideally on cross-border matters.
  • Working knowledge of syndicated loan and bond documentation, and intercreditor arrangements.
  • Exposure to at least one court-supervised restructuring process, such as a scheme of arrangement or a comparable foreign procedure (essential for Senior Associates)

  • Strong understanding of risk and control frameworks

Experience with technology risk, cyber security controls, operational resilience or APRA prudential standards would be highly regarded.

Why Apply?
This role offers the opportunity to join a collaborative and well-regarded organisation where risk management is valued as a key business enabler. You will work closely with senior stakeholders, gain broad exposure across the business and contribute to the ongoing enhancement of a mature risk and compliance framework.

job.title: Director - Operational Risk & Compliance
job.description:
Ethos BeathChapman is partnering with a highly regarded investment and capital management organisation to appoint a Director, Operational Risk & Compliance.
This is a newly created leadership role within the second line of defence, offering the opportunity to shape and enhance enterprise-wide risk and compliance capability within a growing and purpose-driven organisation.
The role has a particular focus on ensuring that technology, cyber, data and information risks are appropriately governed within the broader operational risk management framework. Working closely with first-line business, operations and technology teams, you will help strengthen risk governance, operational resilience and control effectiveness across the organisation.

Key Responsibilities
  • Provide second-line oversight, advice and challenge across operational risk, compliance and resilience activities.
  • Support the development and enhancement of enterprise risk management frameworks, policies and governance arrangements.
  • Partner with business and technology stakeholders to improve risk identification, assessment and treatment processes.
  • Provide oversight of business, cyber, data and information risk management practices from an enterprise risk perspective.
  • Contribute to operational resilience, business continuity and incident management programs.
  • Support the design and implementation of effective risk and compliance controls across key business processes.
  • Deliver risk reporting and insights to executive and board-level stakeholders.
  • Assist with assurance activities, audit remediation and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Promote a strong risk culture through coaching, stakeholder engagement and practical risk advice.
About You
We are interested in speaking with risk professionals who bring a balanced background across operational risk, compliance and governance, together with exposure to data, information and cyber risk management.
You may currently be working in operational risk, enterprise risk, compliance, operational resilience, internal audit or risk advisory within financial services, funds management, banking, insurance or another highly regulated environment.

To be successful, you will likely demonstrate:
  • Experience operating within a second-line risk or compliance function.
  • Strong operational risk and control framework expertise.
  • Knowledge of prudential, regulatory or governance frameworks relevant to regulated organisations.
  • Exposure to technology, cyber, data or information risk management, ideally from a governance and oversight perspective rather than a purely technical role.
  • Experience supporting operational resilience, business continuity or incident management programs.
  • Exceptional stakeholder engagement and influencing skills.
  • The ability to communicate complex risk matters clearly and pragmatically to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience preparing executive-level and board reporting.
Why Consider This Opportunity?
This is an opportunity to join a growing organisation at an important stage of its evolution.
The role offers genuine breadth across enterprise risk, compliance, operational resilience, technology and cyber governance, making it well suited to individuals seeking a diverse and commercially relevant risk leadership position.

job.title: Legal Counsel
job.description:
Legal Counsel -  Insurance & Financial Services
Sydney | Full-Time Opportunity
Circa $200K

Ethos BeathChapman has been exclusively retained by a highly respected global financial institution to appoint a Legal Counsel to its established Australia and New Zealand legal and compliance team.
This is an outstanding opportunity for a commercially minded lawyer seeking to move into, or further develop, an in-house career within a sophisticated international financial services environment. Working closely with an experienced Head of Legal & Compliance, you will provide legal advice across a broad range of matters including insurance and reinsurance arrangements, commercial contracts, regulatory issues, strategic projects and corporate initiatives. The role will have a particular focus on supporting a life insurance business and offers exposure to senior stakeholders, regulators and external counsel.

The Opportunity
As Legal Counsel, you will play a key role in supporting business operations across Australia and New Zealand by:
  • Providing legal and regulatory advice to business stakeholders across a broad range of commercial and operational matters.
  • Drafting, reviewing and negotiating commercial agreements, contracts and related documentation.
  • Supporting insurance and reinsurance transactions and strategic business initiatives.
  • Assisting with regulatory matters and engagement with external stakeholders, including regulators and legal advisers.
  • Contributing to the development and implementation of legal and compliance frameworks.
  • Identifying, assessing and escalating legal risks where appropriate.
  • Supporting projects, transactions and business change initiatives across the organisation.
  • Working collaboratively with legal, compliance and business teams to deliver pragmatic and commercially focused outcomes.
About You
We are interested in speaking with lawyers who possess:
  • Approximately 4-7 years' post-qualification experience.
  • Experience gained within a reputable law firm and/or in-house legal team.
  • Exposure to insurance, reinsurance, life insurance, corporate/commercial law or financial services regulatory matters.
  • Strong drafting, research and analytical capabilities.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • The ability to balance legal risk with commercial outcomes.
  • A collaborative approach and strong attention to detail.
Why Apply?
This opportunity offers the chance to join a globally recognised organisation with a strong reputation, supportive culture and flexible approach to working arrangements. The business  provides a genuine opportunity to broaden your in-house legal experience within a highly regarded financial services environment.

job.title: Financial Crime Surveillance Analyst
job.description:
We are partnering with a prominent Financial Services institution seeing experienced Financial Crime professionals to support a range of regulatory and operational initiatives across Customer Due Diligence (CDD), Enhanced due Diligence, AML Investigations, Transaction Monitoring, and quality control.

This role is ideal for candidates with at least 3 years experience in Financial crime, AML, KYC, PEPs or Financial Crime Operations who have worked across one or more key financial crime disciplines and are comfortable operating in fast-paced environments.
The successful candidate will join a specialist team responsible for protecting the organisation from financial crime risks while ensuring compliance with regulatory obligations and internal standards.

Key Responsibilities;
Customer Due Diligence (CDD) & Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD)
Conduct CDD and EDD reviews for new and existing customers.
Assess customer risk profiles and identify financial crime risk indicators.
Review KYC documentation and verify customer information.
Analyse complex ownership structures, beneficial ownership, source of wealth, and source of funds.
Complete periodic reviews and remediation activities.

AML Investigations
Investigate alerts, referrals, and unusual customer activity.
Conduct detailed customer and transactional analysis.
Identify potential money laundering, fraud, sanctions, or terrorism financing risks.
Escalate suspicious activity in accordance with internal procedures.
Maintain thorough and accurate case records.

Transaction Monitoring
Review and investigate transaction monitoring alerts.
Assess customer behaviour against expected activity patterns.
Identify potentially suspicious transactions and emerging risk trends.
Document findings and recommend appropriate actions.
Ensure adherence to regulatory requirements and service-level expectations.

Quality Control & Assurance
Perform quality reviews of completed AML, KYC, CDD, EDD, and investigation cases.
Identify quality gaps, process inconsistencies, and training opportunities.
Support continuous improvement initiatives and compliance monitoring.
Ensure case management standards and regulatory requirements are consistently met.

Skills & Experiences;
Minimum of 3 years' experience within Financial Crime operations, AML, KYC, Compliance or Financial Crime Risk Functions
Experience working within Banking, Wealth Management, Payments, Insurance, Professional Services or other regulated financial services environments

Experience in one or more of the following;
- Customer Due Diligence (CDD)
- Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD)
- AML Investigations
- Transaction Monitoring
- Quality Control / Quality Assurance
- KYC Remediation
- Customer Onboarding Reviews

Strong understanding of AML/CTF regulations and financial crime risk frameworks
Exposure to sanctions screening, PEP reviews, adverse media screening and/or suspicious activity investigations
Excellent analytical and investigative skills
Ability to assess risk and make sound judgement-based decisions
Strong written and verbal communication skills
High attention to detail and ability to manage competing priorities

job.title: Senior Financial Analyst - FP&A (Fixed Term Contract)
job.description:
An opportunity has arisen for a commercially minded finance professional to join a leading financial services organisation on a 6-9 month fixed-term contract. This role sits within a high-performing Finance team and offers significant exposure to senior stakeholders, including Executive leadership.

You will play a key role in helping the business understand, monitor and manage its cost base by delivering meaningful analysis, forward-looking insights, and performance reporting that supports strategic decision-making.
This position is ideal for an ambitious finance professional looking to further develop their FP&A, performance reporting, or expense analytics experience within a large and complex environment.

Working as part of a central finance team, you will provide driver-based analysis and insights across the organisation's cost base, supporting forecasting, planning, target setting and performance management activities.
You will partner closely with finance teams across multiple business units, transforming complex financial information into clear, actionable insights that influence business outcomes and support Executive decision-making.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Deliver driver-based analysis of expense performance across cost categories, cost growth drivers and financial trends.
  • Provide insightful variance analysis against forecasts, budgets, targets and external benchmarks.
  • Develop clear commentary and recommendations for senior finance stakeholders.
  • Support planning, forecasting and target-setting processes through robust financial modelling and scenario analysis.
  • Contribute to Executive and Board reporting by producing high-quality financial insights and presentations.
  • Partner with divisional and business finance teams to improve performance management and decision support capabilities.
  • Maintain strong governance and controls across financial data, reporting outputs and analytical models.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline, automate and enhance reporting processes to improve efficiency and insight generation.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives across finance reporting and analytics.
About You:

My client is seeking a motivated finance professional with experience in FP&A, management reporting, or performance analysis within banking, financial services, or a large corporate environment.
  • Experience supporting planning, forecasting and financial performance reporting.
  • Strong analytical capability with the ability to interpret financial data and translate findings into practical business insights.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including financial modelling and analysis.
  • Exposure to TM1, Hyperion, SAP, Oracle, Anaplan or similar planning and financial reporting platforms.
  • Experience performing variance analysis, scenario modelling and business performance assessments.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to engage confidently with stakeholders across finance and the broader business.
  • Experience working with BI and reporting tools and analysing large data sets.
  • CA or CPA qualification will be highly regarded.
  • Happy to consider individuals currently on a Working Holiday Visa.
What's on Offer?
  • 6-9 month fixed-term contract with the potential to make a significant business impact.
  • Exposure to senior finance leadership and Executive stakeholders.
  • Opportunity to work within a large, complex financial services environment.
  • High-profile role supporting strategic planning and decision-making.
  • Flexible hybrid working arrangements.
  • Collaborative and high-performing finance team culture.
  • Competitive remuneration package.
For further information on this role or to confidentially apply, please contact Stuart Soper on 02 8227 9200 or apply directly via the Apply for this job button.

job.title: Cyber Risk Consultant

Cyber Risk Consultant | Sydney | Mandarin Speaking
My client is looking for an experienced Cyber Risk Consultant to join its Sydney team, working across Australia, New Zealand, Greater China and Africa.
This is an excellent opportunity for someone with a strong cyber security background who wants to move into the commercial and underwriting side of cyber risk, with a potential pathway towards a Cyber Underwriting career.

Provide cyber risk recommendations to support underwriting and portfolio decisions.
Work closely with underwriters, brokers and clients.

job.title: Financial Planning & Analysis Manager - Financial Services
job.description:
We are partnering with a leading ASX listed financial services organisation to recruit an experienced FP&A Manager from a financial services background.

This is a senior commercial finance opportunity for an experienced candidate from an FP&A or Finance Business partnering background who can combine strong technical capability with commercial insight and stakeholder influence. The role will partner closely with senior finance and business leaders, providing analysis and advice to support performance and strategic decision-making across a significant portfolio.

The Opportunity

Sitting within a high-performing finance function, you will take ownership of key elements of portfolio performance, including revenue reporting and analysis, expense management, budgeting, forecasting and management reporting.

You’ll work across a broad stakeholder group and play an important role in translating complex financial information into clear, commercially focused insights for senior leadership.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Partnering with senior business and finance stakeholders to provide commercial advice and decision support
  • Delivering accurate and timely revenue, expense and portfolio performance reporting
  • Providing insights into P&L performance, key drivers, risks and opportunities
  • Supporting budgeting, forecasting and strategic planning cycles
  • Preparing analysis and commentary for executive, senior management and Board-level reporting
  • Identifying opportunities to improve cost efficiency and overall financial performance
  • Reviewing expense allocation methodologies and assessing their commercial impacts
  • Working cross-functionally with teams across strategy, pricing, operations, marketing, digital and other specialist functions
  • Supporting strategic initiatives and broader finance change programs
  • Driving continuous improvement across reporting, analysis and finance processes
  • Coaching and mentoring team members

About You

We’re looking for an experienced finance professional with a background in large and complex financial services environments.

Experience:

  • Significant experience at Manager or Senior Manager level within financial services
  • Strong commercial finance, FP&A, management reporting and business partnering capability
  • Experience working across both operational and strategic finance matters
  • Strong P&L, revenue, expense and cost management experience
  • Excellent analytical capability and commercial judgement
  • Proven experience partnering with and influencing senior stakeholders
  • The ability to simplify complex financial information and communicate the key commercial story
  • Experience driving change, process improvement and better ways of working
  • Strong communication, presentation and organisational skills
  • Experience coaching or mentoring within a finance environment
  • CA or CPA qualification

job.title: Senior Legal Counsel

job.title: Payroll Manager (Fixed term contract)
job.description:
A leading global professional services organisation is seeking an experienced Payroll Manager to join the business team on a 3-month contract with an immediate start.

This opportunity has been created to provide payroll leadership and additional capacity during a busy period, supporting both business-as-usual payroll operations and key payroll projects.  You will lead a small payroll function and oversee the end-to-end payroll process for approximately 850 employees across both fortnightly and monthly payroll cycles.

This role would suit a hands-on payroll professional who can quickly integrate into a complex environment, provide leadership to the payroll team, and ensure payroll operations continue to run efficiently and compliantly.

Records & Lifecycle Management: Ensure records are properly classified, retained, retrieved and disposed of in line with regulatory requirements.

Digitisation: Manage the transition from physical records to digital, including quality checks, exceptions and approvals for destruction.

Risk & Compliance: Identify information governance risks, manage controls and work with Risk, Legal and business teams to remediate issues.

Supplier Management: Oversee external storage/records suppliers, including performance, contracts and costs.

Reporting: Develop dashboards and executive reporting around governance, compliance, risk and control effectiveness.

Technology & Delivery: Partner with Technology and Product teams to embed governance controls into new solutions and projects.

Ideal Candidate
Someone with experience in Information Management, Records Management or Information Governance, ideally within a regulated environment, who has experience with:

- Records and information lifecycle management
- Regulatory compliance and audit
- Operational risk and controls
- Physical-to-digital records transformation
- Supplier/vendor management
- Microsoft 365 and information governance tools
- Working across Technology, Risk, Legal and business stakeholders

Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Data Analytics, Cyber Security, Risk Management, or a related discipline.

job.title: Senior Data Engineer
job.description:
About the Client
This client is a leading Australian wealth management company that provides superannuation, financial advice, and asset management services. the company traces its origins back to 1846.

About the Role
We are seeking an experienced Senior Data Engineer to join a high-performing Data Engineering team delivering enterprise-scale data solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). This is a hands-on engineering role where you'll design, build and optimise modern data pipelines that enable trusted, scalable data for reporting, analytics and business decision-making.
Working closely with Solution Designers, Data Architects and cross-functional technology teams, you'll play a key role in delivering robust batch and real-time data solutions while driving engineering best practices, mentoring team members and contributing to the continuous improvement of the data platform.

Required Experience:
- Design, develop and maintain scalable batch and real-time data pipelines on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
- Build robust ETL/ELT solutions to ingest, integrate, transform and model data from multiple enterprise source systems.
- Collaborate with Solution Designers, Data Architects and business stakeholders to deliver data solutions aligned to business and technical requirements.
- Develop high-quality, production-ready code using modern software engineering practices.
- Optimise data pipelines for performance, scalability, reliability and cost efficiency. Implement automated testing, monitoring and CI/CD practices to support reliable production deployments.
- Conduct code reviews and provide technical guidance to engineers and delivery partners.
- Troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis and implement long-term improvements.
- Champion engineering standards, reusable frameworks and continuous improvement initiatives across the data engineering function.
- Work collaboratively within Agile delivery teams and contribute to sprint planning, estimation and technical design discussions.

About You
You'll be a passionate Data Engineer who enjoys solving complex engineering problems while delivering reliable, scalable data solutions within enterprise environments.

You'll bring:
- 10+ years' experience in Data Engineering, Software Engineering or ETL Development.
- Strong commercial experience delivering enterprise data solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
- Expertise with BigQuery, Dataflow, Cloud Composer (Airflow), Pub/Sub and Cloud Storage.
- Advanced SQL skills and strong programming experience with Python (Java or Scala also beneficial).
- Strong understanding of ETL/ELT frameworks, data integration and modern data engineering principles.
- Experience designing dimensional data models and enterprise data warehouse solutions.
- Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, Git, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform preferred) and automated testing.
- Strong understanding of data quality, metadata management, monitoring and observability.
- Experience tuning data pipelines for performance, scalability and reliability.
- Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills, with the ability to work across Architecture, Security, Infrastructure and business teams.
- Previous experience mentoring engineers and performing technical code reviews.

Nice to Have
- Experience with streaming technologies such as Pub/Sub or Kafka.
- Experience working within Financial Services, Insurance or other highly regulated industries.
- Exposure to DataOps, DevOps and modern cloud engineering practices.
- Experience with containerisation technologies such as Docker or Kubernetes.
- Google Cloud certifications.

What's on Offer
Opportunity to work on a large-scale enterprise cloud data platform.
Modern GCP technology stack and engineering-led environment.
Collaborative, high-performing team with strong technical leadership.
Exposure to enterprise architecture, cloud transformation and modern data engineering practices.
Flexible working arrangements with hybrid/remote options.

*Melbourne or Sydney

job.title: Senior Data Analyst
job.description:
About the Client
This client is a leading Australian wealth management company that provides superannuation, financial advice, and asset management services. the company traces its origins back to 1846.

About the Role
We are seeking an experienced Senior Data Analyst to join a high-performing Data Engineering team, supporting the delivery of enterprise-wide data initiatives. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of business and technology, translating complex business requirements into clear data specifications that enable the successful delivery of modern data solutions.

Working across large-scale transformation projects, you will collaborate with business stakeholders, architects, data engineers and delivery teams to analyse source data, define business rules, document data requirements and ensure high-quality outcomes throughout the project lifecycle.

This is an excellent opportunity for a technically strong Data Analyst who thrives in project environments and enjoys solving complex data challenges.

Required Experience:
- Partner with business stakeholders, Business Analysts and Subject Matter Experts to understand business processes, project objectives and data requirements.
- Analyse and profile complex source datasets to assess data quality, completeness, relationships and suitability for proposed solutions.
- Translate business requirements into detailed data specifications, business rules, transformation logic and source-to-target mappings.
- Produce and maintain high-quality project documentation, including data dictionaries, mapping documents, lineage, assumptions and traceability artefacts.
- Work closely with Solution Architects, Data Engineers and Developers to ensure requirements are understood and accurately implemented.
- Define data quality, validation and reconciliation rules to support system testing and business acceptance.
- Review implemented solutions, investigate defects and support issue resolution throughout project delivery.
- Identify data risks, dependencies and gaps, providing recommendations to support project decisions.
- Ensure data solutions align with governance, security, privacy and regulatory requirements.
- Provide analytical support throughout the full project lifecycle, from discovery and design through to implementation and transition into production.

About You
You'll be a collaborative and detail-oriented Data Analyst with strong technical capability and experience delivering enterprise data projects.

You'll bring:
5+ years' experience as a Data Analyst, Technical Data Analyst or Data Business Analyst.
Advanced SQL skills with the ability to interrogate, validate and analyse large, complex datasets.
Demonstrated experience producing source-to-target mappings, transformation specifications, business rules and technical documentation.
Strong understanding of data profiling, data quality, reconciliation and metadata management.
Experience working across data migration, integration, data warehouse or cloud data platform projects.
Knowledge of data modelling, data lineage and data governance principles.
Experience working with cloud data platforms such as Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and BigQuery is highly regarded.
Exposure to Python, Power BI, Tableau or modern ETL/data integration tools is advantageous.
Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills, with the ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
Experience working within Agile or hybrid delivery environments.

What's on Offer
Opportunity to work on large-scale enterprise data transformation initiatives.
Collaborative and high-performing Data Engineering team.
Exposure to modern cloud data platforms and technologies.
Flexible working arrangements.
Long-term contract with the opportunity to contribute to strategic business initiatives.

job.title: Senior Consultant – UK
job.description:
Ethos BeathChapman (EBC) is a global group of executive talent and recruitment experts in Australia, Asia and EMEA, with a broader network beyond. Our vision is to connect the world’s exceptional companies to exceptional people.

Established 2005 in Sydney, Ethos BeathChapman’s mid-sized agility and solutions-focused approach enables us to flex where traditional recruitment agencies have failed, and scale beyond the reach of small boutiques with executive recruitment solutions that address the client’s specific needs.

Part of Will, EBC has six offices worldwide in Australia, Singapore, Hong Kong, Japan, Netherlands and the UK. We own Quay Appointments in Australia and CONNECT, EBC’s AI-powered sourcing specialists.

On an international basis, our multidisciplinary expertise covers specialised functions across Banking & Financial Services, Fintech, Technology, Legal & Compliance, Industrial, Consumer, Healthcare and Life Sciences recruitment markets, among others.

At the heart of EBC is how we deliver upon that vision via our progressive behaviours and forward-thinking way of performing. We look to break tradition and truly embrace modern technology, data and analytics as well as best in class enablement support to deliver market leading executive recruitment solutions, tailored for our clients and candidates.

We are living in a changing world – and here at EBC we strive to approach it in a changing way.

​In the UK, we are a start-up organisation seeking leverage EBC’s international client base and to build brand new business on top of that. The key focus will be helping our clients achieve their change & transformation goals via permanent recruitment, interim management and executive search. This is a truly exciting opportunity for someone who wants to help shape and build the UK business, as well as their own personal client base. There will be significant opportunities for personal development as the UK business grows in line with our ambitious plans.

www.ethosbc.com | www.linkedin.com/company/ethos-corporation |
 
The Role:
As a Senior Consultant, you will be in an exceptional role unlike elsewhere: one which truly aims and is designed to take already very strong performers to the next level of exceptional performance. Embark on your strategic journey to develop your candidate and client base alike, as well as accelerating your start with our existing client base and global lead network. You will have the opportunity to work alongside extremely talented and experienced colleagues, as well as innovate with outcomes to deliver strong business mix to clients across search, projects, retained and executive contracting. Take the opportunity to plunge yourself into our progressive ways of working, learn our AI technology, state-of-the-art cloud-based CRM platform and engage heavily with cutting edge talent engagement, marketing, data analysis and research functions that set EBC uniquely apart to take already strong performers to your exceptional performance level.

At Senior Consultant level, EBC engages with you around more strategic client initiatives, regional business development and training around future leadership. You will also be autonomous, able to define business plans competently and work at high level towards wider company outcomes.
​
Experience and Qualifications:
We are looking for high performing, entrepreneurial and collaborative recruiters/headhunters with outstanding work ethics and passion for being the best in your specialised recruitment domain.

You will have at least 3 to 6 years’ experience as a recruitment professional working in an executive search/recruitment firm – whether in large agencies, headhunters, boutiques or otherwise, we are keen to hear from you. You’re able to show evidence of strong revenue performance, existing client networks and growing ability to broadly influence both internally and externally.
University level education and experience within change & transformation recruitment are preferred but not essential.

You will have excellent communication skills, both written & verbal, with a natural flair for relationship building at a senior level.

You will be excited by the prospect of joining a start-up business but with the backing of an existing, successful recruitment business.
​
Location: Initially remote (primarily) with ad-hoc internal meetings (likely locations London and Reading). In the medium-term (Q1 2023), office location will likely be London (Paddington)
​
Our Culture:
A career with EBC revolves on several key principles.

Firstly, joining a mature, high performing group of experts requires people with a strong strategic, highly focused and collaborative approach both internally and across all clients and candidates.

Secondly, our commitment to new ways of working and enablement, data-driven decision-making and AI technology is not just held by upper management but is lived and breathed throughout the organisation. We aim for all new joiners to hold good passion and commitment to innovate, share new ideas and work in forward thinking ways like these.

Lastly, and perhaps most importantly, we are an organisation which values internal relationships as much as external. Being persistent in delivering a world-class service and interactions across colleagues, clients and candidates alike is paramount.

Throughout your journey, we are committed to your success. On hand you will always have the high-powered and finessed support – not just from the experienced mentors on your team at your doorstep, but also the supporting technology, our lead network and our best-in class enablement support function.

job.title: Director
job.description:
Ethos BeathChapman (EBC) is a global group of executive talent and recruitment experts in Australia, Asia and EMEA, with a broader network beyond.

We provide solutions across key recruitment markets including Financial Services, Fintech & Technology, Finance & Corporate Functions, Legal, Commercial and Life Sciences - our vision is to connect the world’s exceptional companies to exceptional people.

At the heart of EBC is how we deliver upon that vision via our progressive behaviours and forward-thinking way of performing. We look to break tradition and truly embrace modern technology, data and analytics as well as best in class enablement support to deliver market leading executive recruitment solutions, tailored for our clients and candidates.
